title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons: Removal of a Rider and Premium Credits
content:
## Removal

Removing a rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons is the customer's own decision and is effective on the date the customer asks. A rider is removed only when the rider is one that can be removed during the base term and the rider status is waiting period or active; the status is read from Bridgewell's records of that rider.

## Billing after removal

On a monthly-billed base, rider billing stops from the next base billing period and nothing already billed is credited.

## Base contract ending

When the base contract is cancelled, the rider ends with it and its unused premium is credited by the same method as set out in retired clause 1 below, which continues to govern that case. When the base expires, the rider premium is fully earned and nothing is credited.

Credit balances are refunded to the original payment method with the base contract's refund.

## Retired clauses, in part

1. The clause that, on an annual-billed or real estate base where removal from an annually billed base credits unused rider premium, a removal no later than the rider's free-look period in calendar days after the add date (counted from the day after the add date through the removal date) is credited all rider premium paid in the term less the rider benefit paid in the term net of reversals, and that a later removal is credited the rider premium paid in the term times the unexpired term days divided by the rider's term days, rounded to the cent, less that same net benefit, is **no longer in force** for a rider the customer removes; such a removal is credited under the current basis for the removal credit. For a rider that ends because its base contract is cancelled it remains in force, the end date taking the place of the removal date: the unexpired term days are the calendar days after the end date through the term end date, and the rider's term days are the days from the later of the term start date and the add date through the term end date, both days counted.
2. The clause that no admin fee applies to a rider removal and that a negative result is credited as zero is **no longer in force** for a rider the customer removes; such a removal carries a removal processing fee under the current basis. For a rider that ends because its base contract is cancelled it remains in force: no admin fee applies, and a negative result is credited as zero.
3. The clause that each rider receives at most one credit per credit reason and period is **no longer in force** for a premium billing correction or for a removal credit, each of which is now limited under its own current basis. Every other rider premium credit is still limited to one per credit reason and period.

## Outcomes at a glance

| Event | Base billed monthly | Base billed annually, or a real estate base |
|---|---|---|
| Customer removes the rider | Billing stops from the next base billing period; nothing already billed is credited | Settled under the current basis for the removal credit |
| Base contract cancelled | The rider ends with the base; nothing already billed is credited | The rider ends with the base; unused premium credited by the method in retired clause 1, with no admin fee and a negative result credited as zero |
| Base contract expires | The rider ends with the base | Premium fully earned; nothing credited |

## Cancelled base (hypothetical inputs)

A rider on an annually billed base, term 1 January through 31 December (365 days), added on 1 January; the base is cancelled on 10 May. Rider premium paid in the term USD 161.89; rider benefit authorized in the term USD 40.00, of which USD 40.00 was reversed. The end is after the 30-day free-look period. Unexpired days: 235 (11 May through 31 December). Credit: 161.89 times 235 divided by 365 is 104.23, less a net benefit of 0.00, giving USD 104.23.

superseded_clauses: Each rider receives at most one credit per credit reason and period.

On an annual-billed or real estate base, when removal_credit_on_annual is true, a removal no later than rider_free_look_days calendar days after added_date (addon_msr_days_since_added) is credited all rider premium paid in the term less addon_msr_term_benefit_paid; a later removal is credited addon_msr_rider_premium_paid_term times addon_msr_unexpired_term_days divided by addon_msr_rider_term_days, rounded to the cent, less addon_msr_term_benefit_paid.
No admin fee applies to a rider removal, and a negative result is credited as zero.
